name: Private Aggregation API (removed)
plain: Noisy aggregate reports from Protected Audience and Shared Storage. Removed in Chrome 152 (Aug 2026).
meaning: Worklet code could contribute values to histograms that a server summed with differential privacy noise. Retired Oct 2025, deprecated Chrome 144, removed in Chrome 152 (released Aug 25 2026). The Aggregation Service is scheduled for phaseout.

access.persistence: Reports delayed 10 min to hours; budget per 10 min and 24 hours
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can't send noisy ad totals from Chrome anymore, since it was removed in August 2026
limits.user_action: Nothing. It used to happen inside ad tests
can: Have sent grouped reports with added noise from ad auctions
Have helped measure ads without naming you
cannot: Name an individual in a report
Work in Edge, Firefox or Safari

story.what_it_is: A Chrome tool for adding up noisy ad numbers in secret. It has been removed.

marketing.name: Private Aggregation API
marketing.pitch: Chrome pitched it as a way to measure ad results with summed, noised reports that hide any one person.

story.for_you: You never saw it work. Ad code in a locked box could add a value to a tally that a server read only with random noise. It was removed in Chrome 152, so you will not meet it.
story.for_makers: It was the reporting arm of Protected Audience and Shared Storage. Advertisers got totals without person level data. With those tools retired, the reports lost their reason to exist.

use_cases.example: An ad network counted how many people saw an ad in a group, with random noise so no single person showed.
A publisher tallied reach and frequency across sites without sharing a person level list.
A game ad campaign got a daily total of ad views and installs, in noisy form.
A video site reported how many viewers watched each ad past 50 percent, in aggregate.
A retailer measured the effect of a retargeting ad without a list of shoppers.
Fraud teams disliked the noise, because it made fake traffic harder to find.

risks: Noise made small campaigns hard to measure

technical_bounds: Contribution budget of 2^16 units per 10 min and per day per origin
Reports are encrypted to an Aggregation Service

abuse: Not meaningful abuse; limited by noise
